name: Edgar
source:
An eternally optimistic youth with insatiable curiosity. He became an adventurer to search for unknown experiences and travelled the world. The last few years sees him throw in his lot with Amakakeru Oyou and develop his reputation as the leading breadwinner, however he is attacked one day by a mysterious monster and the after-effects render him incapable of exploring dungeons and unable to fight.  

Edgar is effectively retired as an active adventurer, but he leverages the experience acquired through years of adventuring and seeks to rebuild the adventurer's guild together with Lucit.

Edgar can manipulate a doll, "Replica", by intoning the command words. This allows him to manipulate the doll's limbs and share its field of vision. Edgar is no longer able to personally join expeditions, but he can still assist his companions with the aid of Replica.

[Spoiler] The drive to explore the unknown and experience new sensations has been with Edgar since he was a child. Even amongst this peers, he spent more time poring through maps imagining routes to far-flung lands than playing outdoors. 

Although the Evil Deity attempts to bait Edgar into servitude by offering to restore the strength lost to him, Edgar comes to terms with the permanent loss of his strength as he is capable of fulfilling his innate desire by serving as Guild Master and guiding the guild to explore the unknown together.

The advantages of controlling the Replica out on the field include its small size which allows it to explore small openings out of reach to ordinary adventurers and its inorganic nature as a magic doll. Unfortunately for Edgar no spare parts to improve the doll exist as the technology and expertise which created the Replica to begin with have long since been lost. [/Spoiler]
